facts.fact: 清晨的墙头岗上，Zeke 收枪，直接从 Four 手里把咖啡杯拿走。
facts.anchor: Zeke holsters his gun and grabs the coffee cup right out of my hands.

facts.fact: 墙头巡逻是有身份的任务，只给最可信最能打的 Dauntless，但也无聊到让人发木。
facts.anchor: Wall patrol is a high-status detail, only for the most trustworthy and skilled Dauntless, but it’s also mind-numbingly boring.

facts.fact: 因为 Dauntless 的电脑够不到这么远，所以墙上固定着信号中继器，把恐惧模拟转发、向外投射。
facts.anchor: So there are signal repeaters fixed to the wall to channel the computer’s simulations and project them outward.

facts.fact: Zeke 抱怨上午要全盘清点：有人数错了武器送货，整整一箱枪不见了。
facts.anchor: We’re missing an entire crate full of guns is what that means.

facts.fact: 夺旗夜被 Eric 推迟到第一轮淘汰之后才办。
facts.anchor: Eric wanted to delay it until after the first round of cuts.

facts.fact: 分队：Eric 先挑 Peter，再挑 Edward、Drew、Molly、Al；Four 这边除 Uriah 外得到 Lynn、Will、Marlene。
facts.anchor: Eric takes Peter, then Edward, Drew, Molly, and Al. In addition to Uriah we get Lynn, Will, and Marlene.

facts.fact: 明知自己怕高，Four 还是把手放上梯子，跟着 Tris 往上爬。
facts.anchor: Then my hands are on the rungs, and I’m following her.

facts.fact: 看见河边火光冲天，Tris 说那大概是 Evelyn 放的火，说得很不情愿。
facts.anchor: “Probably Evelyn,” she says, with obvious reluctance.
